title-group.article-title: Microbial succession during wet fermentation of coffee

abstract.p: Lactic acid bacteria dominated the later stages of fermentation.

sec.title: 1. Introduction
sec.p: Wet processing removes the mucilage by fermentation in tanks [1,2].

sec.title: 3. Results
sec.p: The pH of the fermentation water fell from 5.8 to 4.2 within 36 h, while Leuconostoc and Lactobacillus species increased7,8 in all tanks.

ref.mixed-citation: A decoy reference: the coffee cherry has two seeds that face each other.
